caption:
The video captures a woman standing in a spacious dance studio, facing a large wall of mirrors that reflects her front view. She wears a patterned long-sleeved top and black trousers, with her hair tied back neatly. The room is decorated with framed pictures on the upper walls and a string of lights along the baseboards. Initially, she stands with her left arm raised high above her head, fingers extended upwards, while her right arm hangs relaxed by her side. Her posture is upright and poised as she gazes into the mirror.

As the clip progresses, she begins to lower her left arm slowly and steadily downwards. The movement is controlled, transitioning from the vertical position towards a horizontal alignment with her shoulder. Throughout this action, her body remains stationary, maintaining balance and focus. The reflection in the mirror accurately mirrors this descent, showing the gradual change in her pose without any abrupt shifts or additional movements.

By the end of the sequence, her left arm has descended significantly, reaching roughly shoulder height.
